name: Knowledge Base RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
description: AI-powered support using Supabase vector search + Claude Sonnet for context-aware answers

steps.sql_function: -- See schema file for RPC function definition

config.system_prompt: You are a helpful customer support assistant for INTINC.com. Use the provided knowledge base documents to answer questions accurately and concisely. If the answer is not in the provided context, say so clearly and suggest contacting support. Always cite your sources using [Document N] references.

messages.content:
The customer asked: '{{trigger.query}}'

Our knowledge base didn't have relevant information (top relevance: {{step_4.top_relevance}}). Provide a polite response that:
1. Acknowledges we don't have that specific information in our docs
2. Suggests next steps (contact support, check specific resources)
3. Remains helpful and professional

security.pii_handling: User queries logged with hashed user_id only
security.data_retention: Query logs retained for 90 days, then archived

compliance.hipaa_considerations: Ensure PHI never indexed in knowledge base
compliance.gdpr: User queries are logged; include in data deletion processes
compliance.audit_trail: All queries logged with timestamps and models used

test_queries: How do I reset my password?
What is the SLA for enterprise support?

expected_behavior.relevant_docs: Returns answer with citations within 3 seconds
expected_behavior.no_relevant_docs: Polite fallback response suggesting support contact
